result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both pages show only the unpaid invoices, most overdue first, label each status in words, and correctly show $750.00 still owed on the part-paid invoice. B scores higher because it adds separate Invoice total and Received columns with right-aligned figures and a totals row, and states the currency once in the headers. A uses a consistent $ on every amount but tucks the issue dates into a subline instead of a column, and B's wrapped customer name is only a small flaw. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both pages show only unpaid invoices, put the most overdue first, show a text label for each status and give the part-paid balance of $750.00. A has separate right-aligned columns for invoice total, received and balance due, with the $ stated once in each header, plus a totals row, so the part payment is easier to check. B is a clean dark design, but it puts issue dates and invoice totals in a small subtitle line instead of their own columns, which makes them harder to scan.
